decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet cardboard display builds directly on the firm's core corrugated board and display know-how, so it can interpret market feedback and keep refining it.
The pegboard-back cardboard shelf display is a close variant of the firm's existing display technology, so it fits well with knowledge the firm already holds.
The standard quarter-pallet cardboard display is a core product format that rests squarely on the firm's established knowledge base.
The eighth-pallet cardboard display extends the same core competence to a smaller format, which the firm can easily assimilate and improve.

A wooden display pallet lies outside the firm's paper and cardboard knowledge base, which limits its ability to learn from the product and improve it, so the resources are better used in the core business.
The media-product display draws on core cardboard competence, although the shrinking physical media market makes it riskier than the general-purpose displays.
